description:
Madrid is a wonderful city. In addition to the famous attractions you want to visit, I can show you some hidden corners in the city. I think the best way to show a city's style is the streets where ordinary people live. From the hidden small corners, you can experience the fetters of life that touch people's hearts. Of course, the choice is yours, and we can fully communicate the photo itinerary before the experience begins. I will definitely make your best memories in this beautiful city.
Other things to note
We can discuss the specific meeting place before starting. If you have any questions, please contact me. I will reply in a second.
hostdescription: Soy fotógrafa y estoy haciendo una carrera de estudios internacionales en Madrid y he estado haciendo sección de fotografía desde hace seis años. Hablo chino, español e inglés. Soy profesional en varios estilos de fotografía, celebridades de internet, nicho, parejas ... Me encanta la fotografía, y también he aprendido mucho sobre fotografía, participé en concursos de fotografía, etc.
locationDescription: Puerta del Sol, Civic Square, Royal Palace of Madrid, Temple of Debod, Retiro Park, Crystal Palace, major museums ..... Poetry Block, Malasaña Block, Flea Market ...These places are served as important view for travelers. If you would like to have a plan for other photo session more professional we can discuss the place.
